title: Catalog
description: Everything you sell — the bookings people make, and the events on a date.
recent: {count, plural, one {# booked ahead} other {# booked ahead}}

toast.duplicated: Copied — {name} stays off sale until you put it on.
toast.restored: {name} is back in the catalog, off sale.

confirm.archiveBody: It comes off sale and out of the catalog. Orders and tickets already sold are kept, and you can restore it later.
confirm.archiveSoldOne: {count} tickets are sold for {date}. Archiving takes it off sale — those tickets stay valid and still scan at the gate.
confirm.archiveSoldMany: {count, plural, one {# of these has} other {# of these have}} tickets sold for dates still to come. Archiving takes them off sale — those tickets stay valid and still scan at the gate.

stat.weekUseNote: {used} of {cap} slots and places across your bookings
stat.onSaleNote: On sale now, of everything in this view

emptyKind.bookings: No bookings yet — a lane, a tour, an appointment, an entry ticket.
emptyKind.events: No events yet — a concert, a match, a conference, an exhibition.

moved.title: Bookings and Events are one Catalog now.

chooser.eventsRule: One date, or a few — with its own page

showUp.title: They just show up — no date needed

pickDate.title: They pick a date
pickDate.helper: A day, maybe with a daily limit.

pickTime.title: They pick a date and time

space.title: They book a space or equipment

bundle.title: It combines other bookings
bundle.helper: A bundle sold as one ticket.

date.title: Yes — no daily limit
date.helper: They choose the day they'll visit.

capped.title: Yes — capped per day
capped.helper: Once a date is full it stops selling.

q2.title: Do you limit how many visitors per day?

noLimit.title: No limit
noLimit.helper: Sell as many as you like.

cap.title: Yes, cap it per day
cap.helper: Once full, that date stops selling.

q3.title: Is it led by a guide or host?

fixed.title: No — visitors arrive at a set time

guided.title: Yes — a guide runs each departure

resource.which: Which of these can they book?

wizard.pageDescription: Say what it is and how people book it — the rest follows.

help.how: Answer in your own words — the setup underneath is handled for you.
help.details: The name guests see on tickets, receipts and the booking page.

help.review: This is what goes on sale.

editEvent.title: Edit {title}
editEvent.description: Change the facts, the page and the tickets. Nothing already sold is lost.

editEvent.belowSold: {name} has already sold {count} — its quantity can't go below that.

bulk.noneToPutOn: Everything selected is already on sale.
